# Data Item

```tsx
import { DataItem, DataItemAction } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

A read-only value with its label, like a field that can't be edited: the input .Label, the value in Body/Medium, up to three Button Ghost actions (copy, share…) and the .Text Help. Mirrors the Figma Data Item: Value, Show Buttons and Show Button 2 / 3.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<DataItem
  label={args.label}
  labelInfo={args.showLabelInfo ? args.labelInfo : undefined}
  value={args.value}
  actions={
    args.showButtons &&
    demoActions.slice(0, args.buttons).map((action) => (
      <DataItemAction
        key={action.label}
        aria-label={action.label}
        onClick={args.onAction}
      >
        <HugeiconsIcon icon={action.icon} />
      </DataItemAction>
    ))
  }
  helpText={args.showHelpText ? args.helpText : undefined}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Data Item: a read-only value under the input .Label, with up to three Button Ghost actions after it and the .Text Help below, the three rows touching (no gap).
- .Label: Label/Small in Text/Primary; the Info icon (Icon/Primary, 16px) 4px after it opens `labelInfo` in a Tooltip.
- Field: the value in Body/Medium, Text/Primary, with 4px above and below (32px tall with the buttons), and the buttons 8px after it, 8px apart.
- .Text Help: Body/Small in Text/Secondary.

Parts:
- `DataItemAction`: Figma Data Item Button: a Small icon-only Button Ghost (32px, 16px icon). Give it an `aria-label`.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`DataItemProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma .Label: Label/Small in Text/Primary. |
| `labelInfo?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma .Label Show Icon Info: the tooltip text of the Info icon. |
| `value` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Value: Body/Medium in Text/Primary; wraps when long. |
| `actions?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Buttons (with Show Button 2 / 3): one to three `<DataItemAction>`, 8px apart. |
| `helpText?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma .Text Help: Body/Small in Text/Secondary. |

`DataItemProps`

## Rules

- Import `DataItem` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
